# Autogenerated documentation pipeline

Kamacite admits autogenerated documentation through bounded evidence artifacts:

```text
source envelopes
  -> language documentation facts
  -> documentation IR assembly
  -> rendered projections and optional runnable-cell receipts
```

Language documentation facts are collector outputs for Rust, Nickel, and Steel. They bind source-envelope identity, source byte spans, collector identity, item IDs, signatures or contract summaries, runnable-cell references, dependency identities, diagnostics, checked laws, and non-claims.

The facts do **not** prove compiler correctness, evaluator soundness, runtime behavior, source-language semantic equivalence, authorization, or rendered-output authority. Rendered Markdown/HTML/AsciiDoc remains a projection. WASM-backed examples are execution adapter evidence only; WASM module identity never replaces source-envelope, documentation-facts, documentation-IR, or receipt identity.

`kamacite docs collect|check|render --config docs/site.ncl` evaluates the exact Nickel source against the checked docs contract, validates the typed projection, completes the corresponding documentation IR/fixture or renderer work, and emits a deterministic action receipt binding source, contract, evaluator, projection, action/profile, IR, and output identities. `docs run-cells` fails unless a bounded runner actually executes. `docs update` fails unless a receipt-producing mutation occurs; `docs update --dry-run` succeeds only as an explicit `planned` outcome and emits no completion receipt.
